eventDetail.scope: The 2nd International Conference on Computational Intelligence for Smart Power System and Sustainable Energy (CISPSSE-2026) is a premier interdisciplinary forum dedicated to the evolution of resilient, global energy systems. By uniting pioneers across fields like Smart Grid technologies, Renewable Energy Integration, and Cybersecurity, the conference fosters innovation in Intelligent Energy Management and advanced Circuits/VLSI Technology. With specialized tracks covering Electric Vehicles, Energy Storage, and Sustainable Computing, CISPSSE-2026 provides a comprehensive platform to explore state-of-the-art research and cutting-edge solutions for a sustainable future.
